title: An aging-sensitive secreted phospholipase confers neuroprotection and cognitive resilience
title_zh: 一种对衰老敏感的分泌型磷脂酶赋予神经保护和认知韧性
abstract: Cognitive reserve theory posits that compensatory mechanisms during aging stave off cognitive decline and lower risk for Alzheimer’s disease. Here, in a screen for hippocampal dentate granule cell (DGC) synapse loss-induced factors in mice, we identified a secreted phospholipase, Pla2g2f, whose expression increases in DGCs during aging and is associated with cognitive resilience in humans. Pla2g2f deletion in DGCs exacerbates aging-associated pathophysiological changes, including synapse loss, inflammatory microglia, reactive astrogliosis, impaired neurogenesis, lipid dysregulation, lipid droplet accumulation and hippocampal-dependent memory loss. Conversely, boosting Pla2g2f in DGCs during aging is sufficient to prevent these pathophysiological alterations in hippocampal–cortical circuits, protect memory and prophylactically modify trajectory of cognitive decline. Mutagenesis of the catalytic site of PLA2G2F prevented lipid droplet mobilization and reduction of reactive gliosis and inflammatory microglia. Neuronal PLA2G2F mediates intercellular signaling to decrease lipid droplet and cholesterol ester load in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived microglia. Our findings implicate PLA2G2F as a compensatory neuroprotective broadcast signal that maintains lipid homeostasis to counteract aging-associated cognitive decline. This study identifies a secreted phospholipase in the hippocampal dentate gyrus that mediates an aging-sensitive compensatory mechanism promoting cognitive resilience and neuroprotection.
abstract_zh: 认知储备理论假设，在衰老过程中产生的补偿机制可延缓认知衰退，并降低患阿尔茨海默病的风险。在此，我们在小鼠海马齿状回颗粒细胞（DGC）突触丢失诱导因素的筛选中，鉴定出一种分泌型磷脂酶 Pla2g2f，其在DGCs中的表达随衰老而增加，且与人类的认知韧性相关。Pla2g2f 在DGCs 中的敲除加剧了与衰老相关的病理改变，包括突触丢失、炎性小胶质细胞激活、反应性星形胶质细胞增生、神经发生受损、脂质代谢紊乱、脂滴积聚以及海马依赖性记忆丢失。相反，在衰老过程中增强DGCs 中的 Pla2g2f 表达足以预防海马-皮层电路中的这些病理改变，保护记忆并主动修饰认知衰退的轨迹。PLA2G2F催化位的突变阻止了脂滴动员和反应性胶质细胞炎症微胶质细胞的减少。神经元 PLA2G2F 通过细胞间信号传递，降低人诱导多能干细胞来源微胶质细胞中的脂滴和胆固酯酯负荷。我们的研究结果表明，PLA2G2F 是一种补偿性的神经保护信号，通过维持脂质稳态来对抗与衰老相关的认知衰退。本研究鉴定出海马齿状回中一种分泌型磷脂酶，介导一种对衰老敏感的补偿机制，促进认知韧性和神经保护。
